current.text: Re-signed with Washington on a cheap three-year deal, partly for the mentoring he gives young players.
It is unclear how much he will play this season.
He is not in Washington's projected starting five of Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr.
Washington has a crowded group of wings and guards.
Experts expect a 10 or 11 man rotation with many wings competing for minutes and for the fifth starter spot, so his minutes are at risk.
Washington is trying to compete for the play-in, so late-season rest and minutes cuts should be less likely than in past years.

note: Yahoo ranks him 242 and ESPN 285, both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season, so he is well outside our 144 drafted players. On about 20 projected minutes, his only small plus is FT% on low volume (86.3% on 1.8 attempts) with few turnovers. Last season he shot 42.0% from the field with 2.8 assists, so leave him on waivers. Check early on whether he wins rotation minutes in Washington's crowded wing group.
